title: Today, Oct 8, Iran's leader, Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei's message on the occasion of Law Enforcement week.
text:
Today, Oct 8, Iran's leader, Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei's message on the occasion of Law Enforcement week."

"VO1, Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran's Supreme Leader (Farsi) (00:00 - 01:00): "Security is one of the most important divine blessings, and its establishment in various parts of dear Iran, from large cities to the smallest population units in villages and neighborhoods, from rigorous border guarding in difficult weather conditions and diverse climates of mountains to seas, from plains and forests to the most central points of the country,is owed to the bravery and courage of the selfless and hardworking forces of the Law Enforcement Command of the Islamic Republic of Iran (FARAJA) as one of the strong pillars of the country's security. This security provides various social, moral, and public comfort dimensions in society, and such a valuable service, in addition to being a jihad in the way of God, possesses strong social support. The prominent role of FARAJA at various levels, from commanding and staff ranks to police stations and outposts, to ensure security has become more pronounced in recent years.”"

"VO2, Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran's Supreme Leader (Farsi) (01:01 - 01:48): "The signs of this impact became more apparent during the second and third imposed wars. The focus and persistence of the criminal American-Zionist enemy to strike various levels of the Law Enforcement Forces (FARAJA) from the highest echelons to its frontline officers, demonstrated the importance of this institution more than ever. However, this desperate effort and the insidious attacks on the pillars of the system and societal security, for which there is no parallel in history, did not cause the brave forces of FARAJA to retreat even an inch from their mission; instead, they continued to fulfill the same roles and duties in the streets and vehicles that they performed in their headquarters.”"

"VO3, Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran's Supreme Leader (Farsi) (01:49 - 02:47): "For this reason, the oppressed yet powerful nation of Iran is grateful for the tireless efforts and sacrifices of those serving the country's security; in turn, the law enforcement forces, which, like the Army and the IRGC; emerge from the depths of society, can enhance public trust in this valuable institution through trust-building behavior. At times, the hard work and sacrifices of security guardians may be taken for granted by some individuals, and it is precisely this sense of being wronged and unrecognized that increases their reward in the eyes of God. The comprehensive strengthening of security forces in terms of human resources, hardware, and software, especially the advancement of technologies, including the purposeful use of artificial intelligence in data analysis; plays a crucial role in the quality and facilitation of law enforcement missions.”
